name: AI Hub
author: Design Nexus
description: One bar icon for AI tooling: usage and quotas, live herdr agents, past sessions, loaded skills, and local model servers (LM Studio and Ollama). Tabs and servers can each be hidden. Combines design-nexus.ai-usage, jankeesvw.herdr, sid.sessions, oliwier.agent-skills-manager and design-nexus.lmstudio.

barWidget.description: Usage, live agents, sessions, skills and local models behind one icon. Left click opens, right click jumps to Local, middle click refreshes. The gear in the panel hides tabs.
